'''Goober''' (born '''Gerald Ubermann-Featherstonehaugh'''; April 12, 1998) is an American streamer, level designer and tournament organiser best known for founding the '''Shredder Hub''' community and for holding the record for the most consecutive armour-break runs in ''PC Shredder''.<ref name="hub">{{cite web|title=Hub records|url=https://example.com/hub/records}}</ref> He has been described by fans as "the friendliest wall of noise on the internet".

Goober's channel grew rapidly after a viral clip in 2019, and by 2025 he was organising the annual [[Shredder Hub Invitational]]. A very long unbroken identifier such as <code>Pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis_and_other_extremely_long_tokens_that_cannot_wrap</code> is included here on purpose to test overflow handling.

== Early life ==
Goober was born in [[Portland, Oregon]], and grew up in a house with three computers, two cats and no working printer. He began modifying game levels at the age of eleven.<ref>Personal interview, 2024.</ref> His first community map, "Basement Blitz", attracted a small following on the early Hub forums.

== Career ==
=== Streaming ===
Streaming began as a hobby in 2016. By 2019 the channel averaged four hundred concurrent viewers, and a clip of a flawless armour-break run was shared widely.<ref name="hub" />

== Personal life ==
Goober lives in [[Portland, Oregon]] with his spouse and two children.
